In mathematics, the '''paratingent cone''' and '''contingent cone''' were introduced by {{harvs|txt|authorlink=Georges Bouligand|last=Bouligand||year=1932}}, and are closely related to [[tangent cone]]s.

==Definition==
Let <math>S</math> be a nonempty subset of a [[Real number|real]] [[normed vector space]] <math>(X, \|\cdot\|)</math>.

# Let some <math>\bar{x} \in \operatorname{cl}(S)</math> be a point in the [[Closure (topology)|closure]] of <math>S</math>. An element <math>h \in X</math> is called a ''tangent'' (or ''tangent vector'') to <math>S</math> at <math>\bar{x}</math>, if there is a sequence <math>(x_n)_{n\in \mathbb{N}}</math> of elements <math>x_n \in S</math> and a sequence <math>(\lambda_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}</math> of positive real numbers <math>\lambda_n > 0</math> such that <math>\bar{x} =  \lim_{n \to \infty} x_n</math> and <math>h = \lim_{n \to \infty} \lambda_n (x_n - \bar{x}).</math>
# The set <math>T(S,\bar{x})</math> of all tangents to <math>S</math> at <math>\bar{x}</math> is called the ''contingent cone'' (or the ''Bouligand tangent cone'') to <math>S</math> at <math>\bar{x}</math>.<ref>
{{cite book
 |last1                = Johannes
 |first1               = Jahn
 |year                 = 2011
 |title                = Vector Optimization
 |url                  = https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-642-17005-8
 |series               = 
 |location             = 
 |publisher            = Springer Berlin Heidelberg
 |pages                = 90–91
 |doi                  = 10.1007/978-3-642-17005-8
 |isbn                 = 978-3-642-17005-8
}}
</ref>

An equivalent definition is given in terms of a distance function and the limit infimum.
As before, let <math>(X, \|\cdot \|)</math> be a normed vector space and take some nonempty set <math>S \subset X</math>. For each <math>x \in X</math>, let the ''distance function'' to <math>S</math> be 
:<math>d_S(x) := \inf\{\|x - x'\| \mid x' \in S\}.</math> 
Then, the ''contingent cone'' to <math>S \subset X</math> at <math>x \in \operatorname{cl}(S)</math> is defined by<ref>
{{cite book
 |last1                = Aubin
 |first1               = Jean-Pierre
 |last2                = Frankowska
 |first2               = Hèléne
 |year                 = 2009
 |chapter              = Chapter 4: Tangent Cones
 |title                = Set-Valued Analysis
 |url                  = https://doi.org/10.1007/978-0-8176-4848-0_4
 |series               = Modern Birkhäuser Classics
 |location             = Boston
 |publisher            = Birkhäuser
 |publication-date     = 2009
 |page                 = 121
 |doi                  = 10.1007/978-0-8176-4848-0_4
 |isbn                 = 978-0-8176-4848-0
}}</ref> 
:<math> T_S(x) := \left\{v : \liminf_{h \to 0^+} \frac{d_S(x + hv)}{h} = 0 \right\}. </math>
